name: Wakeman Boys & Girls Club Summer Day Camp
description_short: A Boys & Girls Club day camp for children who finished kindergarten through 8th grade, run in themed weeks from 9 am to 3:30 pm at the club's Southport clubhouse in Fairfield and its two Bridgeport clubhouses. Days mix indoor and outdoor sports with daily art, STEM and game time; a club membership is required.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund, less the $25 a week nonrefundable deposit, if written notice of withdrawal arrives before the final balance is due three weeks before the camp week. No partial refunds after that except for illness or injury with a doctor's note. Memberships are not refundable.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 summer camp page: 9 weeks of day camp for campers finishing grades K to 8 in June 2026 (must be at least a rising first grader in fall 2026), 9:00 am to 3:30 pm, at the Southport, Smilow-Burroughs and Madison Avenue clubhouses. Day camp uses tiered pricing, but the tier prices do not appear in the page text. Before care $28 a week (7:30 to 9 am) and after care $40 a week (3:30 to 5:30 pm). Care 4 Kids accepted and financial assistance available. Annual membership $60 per youth is required. Lunch: bring your own at Southport; free lunch at the Bridgeport clubhouses. Email and phone are for the Southport Clubhouse contact.
Researched by Claude from this page. Southport Clubhouse page: 385 Center Street, Southport, CT. Southport is a village of Fairfield, so the city is Fairfield. No zip is given.

Southport is a village of Fairfield and is not in cities.py, so I used Fairfield.
No week dates or day camp prices are in the page text (the 9 weeks are not dated and the tier prices are likely in an image). Publish without sessions or prices?
Grades are the grades campers finished in June 2026 (K to 8), not the grade they enter in fall.
